lagMethod.definition: Calendar-day difference between ALFRED realtimeStart and observationDate.
lagMethod.interpretation: This measures the date-level delay encoded by the ALFRED realtime_start field. It does not infer an intraday publication time.
lagMethod.availableAtConvention: realtimeStart at 23:59:59.999 UTC remains the conservative candidate AvailableAt convention.

notes: No candidate is admitted by this analysis.
The analysis uses the ALFRED realtimeStart evidence retained with each prepared candidate.
Calendar-day lag is not equivalent to exact publication latency.
No intraday availability time is invented.
Unusual lags are retained for inspection rather than automatically corrected.
Calibration and official HESI remain unchanged.
